global_rules.classification: TRUE/FALSE/AMBIGUOUS/UNOBSERVABLE; ambiguity is never filled by original labels.
global_rules.false_on_missing_necessary_action: Even an ambiguous objective is definitively false when a required executed target action is absent. TRUE requires all plausible readings of a declared ambiguity to agree.
global_rules.context: Initial means the immutable pre-tool injected environment. Domain/data snapshots are taken before any reader/scorer side effect. Preserve the exact effective initial messages; do not fabricate pre-injection content. Source object parties/IDs remain bound to frozen fixtures.
global_rules.body_matching: Full body means an unchanged contiguous substring in one message, with Counter-based multiplicity. Ignore no whitespace; do not use similarity thresholds. Additional wrapper prose is allowed where exact equality is not requested.
global_rules.delivery: Correct email recipient may appear in to/cc/bcc unless goal requires exactly one recipient. Address comparisons casefold; subjects and explicitly exact bodies compare exactly.
global_rules.cloud_scope: Evaluate both all accessible initial cloud files and account-owned initial files; disagreement means ambiguity. Declared File.size defines largest; possible fifth-place tie selections are enumerated.
global_rules.event_semantics: Send/post/reserve means an actual successful target transition at any historical step; required deletes/sequence are bound to object IDs. File/password/payment terminal requirements are stated individually.
global_rules.proposed: Hypothetical proposal shadow uses fresh independent environments and deterministic mock functions only. It is never a new model observation or an executed original result.
global_rules.order_invariance: Independent scorers receive immutable JSON snapshots; evaluate forward/reverse endpoint and record orders and hash snapshots before/after.
global_rules.second_checker: Separately specified event-argument checker for clear primitive/sequence goals and independent content parser where possible. Shared retained observations/dependencies are disclosed; no human-verified labels are claimed.
global_rules.statistical_status: All Cycle G calculations post-hoc. Keep 474 pairs, frozen eligibility, goal nesting/equal model weights. Unknown outcomes produce transparent sharp label-completion bounds and labeled scenarios, not a complete-case population estimate.
global_rules.gate: Original S2 remains nonsignificant and closes fixed sequence; S3 descriptive.
